input.description: all 238 pinned Cyclic(43) objective-12 rotation representatives

normalization: fix switch bit s_0=0; switching a rotated source is the rotation of a switch of its representative
pass_condition: For every one of the 238 normalized switching formulas, either produce a satisfying assignment whose decoded 43-vertex coloring independently verifies as good43, or produce a complete independently checkable UNSAT certificate.
failure_condition: Any UNKNOWN, missing source, unchecked certificate, incomplete formula, or failed physical decoding fails the milestone.
scope: One complete source-indexed union of global switching classes; no claim that the 238 classes are pairwise disjoint is needed for exclusion.
stop_rule: Publish and yield after the complete 238-source decision; do not begin another construction family in this pass.
